text:
ana: Quick FYI from the mobile pass — on narrow widths the left nav currently slides over and the table header flickers (y shifts ~6px) when the overlay appears. Captured on Pixel 5 emu: https://img.redwood.test/console/2026-03-flicker.png

tom: Reproduced. Looks like the header's sticky offset recomputes when the modal backdrop is painted. Probably a layout thrash because we change `overflow` on the body during open.

jess: Thoughts: for <420px switch to a bottom-sheet pattern for filters and column toggles (less heavy). Keep route nav accessible via a compact project switcher in the header. Bottom-sheet avoids interacting with sticky.

sam: If we must keep slide-over at 421-720px, we should make it a full-screen modal (position: fixed; inset: 0) so the header isn't sticky at the same time. That was my fix in another app.

ana: small nit: current label for columns is "Show columns" but it's persistent. Recommend "Columns & density" with a one-line helper: "Choose visible columns and row density (saved)". Will reduce confusion.

tom: Implementation note: add breakpoint token `--bp-sidebar-bottomsheet: 420px;` and use it in JS and CSS. I'll add `aria-hidden` on main content when modal is open and a focus trap.

jess: Accessibility checklist: focusable close button inside sheet, ESC to close, screenreader announces "Columns & density dialog", bottom-sheet should not steal scroll from page (use inert or aria-hidden). Also ensure tap targets >=44px.

sam: Table overflow: long model IDs and URLs are causing horizontal scroll when we stack rows. Proposal: `word-break: break-word;` on token cells and show a compact pill with `...` and a copy button. Example pill: `span.token { max-width: 160px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }` and on tap show full truncated content in toast with copy.

ana: UX experiment idea: A/B for 2 weeks. Variant A: stacked cards (full-row tap target, icons secondary). Variant B: compact rows but increase vertical padding to meet 44px min target. Metrics: tap accuracy, conversion to details, accidental kebab opens.

tom: Dev tasks: 1) add breakpoint token and CSS for bottom-sheet + full-screen modal, 2) header hides search behind icon at <=480px (aria-label="Open search"), 3) column copy change.

jess: Also add unit tests for focus trap and keyboard close. Sam, can you work on token wrapping + clipboard microcopy?

sam: Yep. Will include a small inline tooltip for truncated tokens: "Long ID. Tap to copy" and make sure VoiceOver reads the full value on long-press.

ux-bot: Reminder: update design tokens doc (sources/design/tokens.md) and add a note in console/accessibility.md about bottom-sheet patterns.

ana: Thanks everyone 44d I'll put together the A/B plan + recruitment for 6 usability sessions and create the feature flag in the repo. Will post PR links and a short demo video when ready.
